hero.headline: We turn real places into measurable digital twins.
hero.sub: Drone capture · 360° interiors · photogrammetry · browser-based digital twins
hero.caption: A real Aeromine capture, in your browser

problem.title: Most site data dies in a folder.
problem.lead: A survey flight produces gigabytes of truth about a site. Then it gets exported, zipped, emailed once, and never opened again. Three reasons:

reasons.title: The file needs a specialist.
reasons.body: Point clouds and meshes open in software the client, the site manager and the investor do not have and will not install.

reasons.title: It is a snapshot, not a record.
reasons.body: One flight, one moment. Nothing links this month's reality to last month's.

reasons.title: The knowledge stays with one person.
reasons.body: Measurements, volumes and notes live in someone's project folder.

problem.quote: A model nobody can open is not documentation. It is storage.

engine.title: One engine: capture, model, twin.
engine.lead: The same three steps run over every site. Only the subject changes.

steps.name: Capture
steps.body: RTK drone flights for exteriors and terrain. 360° camera for interiors and walkthroughs. Planned overlap and ground control, so it is measurable.

steps.name: Model
steps.body: Photogrammetric processing to point cloud and textured mesh. Digital terrain models, contours, areas and volumes. Exports engineers already use: Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, .dwg.

steps.name: Twin
steps.body: Opens in a browser: no download, no plugin, no licence. Information layers on top of geometry: keypoints, notes, measurements. Re-fly it and the twin gains a timeline instead of a replacement.

diff.title: A 3D model is geometry. A digital twin is geometry that knows things.

rows.twin: Shape, texture, and an information layer on top
Opens in any browser, on any device
Every capture kept, so change is visible

rows.model: Read it, and that is all
rows.twin: Measure it, annotate it, share it, track against it

fast.title: We own every step, so custom is cheap.

cols.title: We fly it.
cols.body: In-house RTK drone operations and 360° capture. No subcontracted pilot, no scheduling chain.

cols.title: We process it.
cols.body: Agisoft Metashape, DJI Terra, Pix4D, Blender. The processing decisions are made by the people who planned the flight.

cols.title: We build the viewer.
cols.body: React, Three.js, React Three Fiber. AeroVIEW OS, a 3D mall map and standalone model viewers. All ours, all built in-house.

fast.quote: If the twin you need does not exist yet, we build it rather than quote for it.

steps.title: Scoping call.
steps.body: You describe the site and what you need to prove or measure. We tell you what is flyable and what is not.

steps.title: Flight.
steps.body: One visit. Drone exterior, 360° interior where it is needed, ground control where accuracy demands it.

steps.title: Processing & delivery.
steps.body: Point cloud, mesh, terrain model, volumes and plans, in the formats your engineers already open.

steps.title: The twin goes live.
steps.body: Your deliverable opens in a browser. Re-fly whenever you need, and the timeline builds itself.

aeroviewOs.title: The project your client can actually log into.
aeroviewOs.intro: Our own platform, built in-house. It closes the distance between the engineer and the client.
aeroviewOs.positioning: Upload what you already have, photos, videos or PDFs, and your client sees the project progress in a browser. Drone captures, 3D models and 360° tours are an upgrade, not a requirement.

features.title: Every update becomes a phase.
features.body: Photos, a video, a PDF or a drone capture: whatever you upload sits beside the last one with its date, so the client sees a timeline instead of a replaced file.

features.title: Progress, stage by stage.
features.body: Foundation, roofing, plumbing, external works, final inspection, each carrying a live percentage.

features.title: Dates the client can see.
features.body: Start date, target date and overall completion, in the open.

aeroviewOs.stagesTitle: 13 preset stages, ready on day one
aeroviewOs.stagesLead: Seeded on project creation, so there is no setup. Bilingual out of the box.
aeroviewOs.notLead: We would rather you know before you ask.
notItems: No document management beyond files attached to updates and material invoices.
No scheduling or dependencies. Stages have an order, not a critical path. It is not a Gantt tool.
No cost tracking. Materials record quantity and an invoice URL, not budget versus actual.
No subcontractor accounts. The roles are company, buyer, platform.
Notifications are in-app only, and there is no mobile app. It is responsive web.
